title: Debunking Ayurveda’s Biggest Myths
description:
Ayurveda is often praised as “ancient science,” but what happens when we actually open the sacred texts? In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we expose the bizarre claims about human anatomy and embryology in Ayurveda. From hearts with 24 vessels to 360 bones, missing kidneys, six layers of skin, and rituals to guarantee male children—this is the so-called “wisdom” still taught in Ayurveda colleges.

We dive into comedies like sperm vs menstrual blood deciding the baby’s sex, mantras to influence conception, and even recipes for changing a child’s gender through nostrils. The misogyny and pseudoscience buried in these texts reveal why Ayurveda should never be mistaken for real medicine.

Join us as we debunk these outdated beliefs with science, anatomy, and logic. If you support scientific temper and evidence-based medicine, share this video to spread awareness against pseudoscience. Let’s make sure the next generation of students doesn’t waste their future studying unscientific dogma in the name of “ancient wisdom.”

#AyurvedaExposed #Pseudoscience #ScientificTemper #DebunkingMyths

00:00 Cold open, disclaimer, setup  
00:45 Anatomy claims: heart, “consciousness,” and vessels  
02:40 Counting the body: bones, vessels, muscles, organs  
05:00 What’s missing: lungs, kidneys, and the sidelined brain  
06:30 Embryology myths & sex determination  
09:15 Skin layers & misogyny  
11:10 Dangerous pregnancy/childbirth advice & wrap-up
